source: any small single-purpose CLI with a build step, fewer than about 2000 lines
query: Use the codebase-to-course skill to build an onboarding course for this repository.
expected_behavior: Classifies the repository as a CLI and anchors the course on a documented invocation rather than inventing a user interface or customer journey
Produces fewer than six modules, merging setup with the system map and testing with the trace, because the repository has one operational boundary
Does not create a delivery or deployment module when the repository has no release evidence; records that absence as undocumented instead of omitting it silently
States the edit-to-result loop from evidence: whether a change requires a rebuild or restart before it takes effect, citing the script or config that settles it
Names where the command's output appears, so a newcomer knows which window a print statement lands in
Records every top-level directory in the manifest as either taught or a coverage gap with a reason
Runs the builder successfully and reports the exact index.html path
